speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: That wand. The straight one. Judith will take the one that looks like a song.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I will take the one the willow gives me. I am not choosing a lesson with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One each, when I cut. Nobody has a hull yet. Sit still enough for a knife.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I am sat. The book is on my knee, and it is dry, and it is shut until there are boats.
